note: Sanctions: no match found for 'Biorad Medisys Private Limited' on OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK or BIS Entity List in the sources reachable; however the sanctions-list pages themselves could not be queried directly (search backend down), so this is null rather than a verified negative. Important disambiguation: this Indian entity is NOT the US company Bio-Rad Laboratories Inc. — search engines conflate them; do not attribute Bio-Rad Laboratories' sanctions or litigation profile to this company. Litigation is real and documented on Indian Kanoon: a Supreme Court arbitration petition brought against the company by Thermopeutix Inc (2019), a Karnataka HC criminal revision petition in which the company is the complainant (cheque-dishonour context, decided 2022), a 2026 Karnataka HC writ where it is party no. 3, and two MP State Consumer Commission complaints (2023) naming it as opposite party over a medical device. Per project rule 2 these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds.
